scope: Proposition 11.3 of the manuscript “Quasi-isometric recognition of virtually polycyclic groups” (preprints/quasi-isometric-recognition-of-virtually-polycyclic-groups-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 255 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c7261a742d7ca883), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 67. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let G be a connected simply connected real-triangulable unimodular Lie group with height homomorphism π : G → W. Let H be a finitely generated amenable group quasi- isometric to G. Assume the uniform bounded-height conclusion of Theorem 1.4 for the family of self-quasi-isometries transferred from left translations of H. Then there is a finite-index normal subgroup H0 ≤ H and a homomorphism τ : H0 → W whose kernel is locally virtually nilpotent. In particular, H is elementary amenable.
